# LaplacianSpectrumTopology

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The eigenvalue distribution of the graph Laplacian, encoding global connectivity features like dimensionality and clustering. Directly determines spectral dimension and thus criticality, providing a topological handle for tuning network behavior in TCC architectures.
